description: The chart, Figure 5, represents the distribution of deceived conversations across varying degrees of ambiguity, using a nested pie chart format with two concentric circles. The chart is divided into six slices, corresponding to three categories for both the outer and inner circles. The outer circle represents "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and is segmented into "Deceived" (dark red, approximately 57.9%), "Partially" (yellow, approximately 31.6%), and "Not Deceived" (green, approximately 10.5%). The inner circle represents "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)" and is similarly divided into "Deceived" (dark red, approximately 67.6%), "Partially" (yellow, approximately 23.5%), and "Not Deceived" (green, approximately 8.8%). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and a legend is provided to the right of the chart, explaining the color coding for the categories. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded.
